annotations.text:
Global Analytics, 1.10.20. One machine-wide view opened from a new titlebar button beside Plugins.

Top to bottom: scope and range, filters, five totals, a chart of the chosen measure over time, a breakdown by provider and model, workspace, team or plan, then tabs created and allowance per provider account. It ends with a link to the team Board. It is not a feed of plan events.

Where the figures come from. Tokens, turns, providers, models and plans were read read-only from the dev KPI ledger (~/.codeterm-dev/kpi_ledger.db, 4,435 token_usage rows, Sep 11 17:50 to Sep 14, bucketed by UTC day). No production ledger exists on this machine. Allowance is the latest usage_snapshots row per provider on this machine, read 11:23.

Workspace and tabs created are recorded nowhere yet, so they are drawn in their not-recorded state. Bracketed amber text marks the only placeholders.

Needs the owner's approval before implementation. task_rli26s (host capability) and task_w1du4w (core plugin) wait on it. The Contract frame names two recording additions the host task must make: a workspace on each event, and a tab-created record.
